findings.title: align-items mixin passes modern values to legacy box-align properties
findings.body: The `align-items` mixin writes the argument straight into `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align`. Those legacy properties use different keywords: `start`/`end` instead of `flex-start`/`flex-end`, and they have no `baseline` in some engines. With the `baseline` and `flex-*` values used here, the legacy declarations are invalid and silently ignored. `-ms-align-items` is not a real property. Map the values to their legacy equivalents, or drop these prefixes.

findings.title: order mixin values differ between legacy and modern syntax
findings.body: `-webkit-box-ordinal-group` starts at 1, while modern `order` defaults to 0. Elements that are not given an order use 0 in modern browsers but 1 in legacy box layout. As a result, `.extra-info-wrapper` (order 2) and `.panel` (order 3) do not keep the same relative ordering against unordered siblings across implementations.

findings.title: float inside flex container is ignored; button alignment lost
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, so `float: right` on the button and `float: left` on `.topic-avatar` have no effect. The button that used to sit on the right will now follow the description directly. Use `margin-left: auto` on the button to keep it right-aligned.
